stemi_transfer.title: STEMI Transfer
stemi_transfer.trigger: Transfer request for STEMI or cardiac emergency.
steps: Arrange emergent transportation via MedSTAR Transport Request Teams chat.
Contact Interventional Cardiologist via AMiON.
Obtain sending physician name and callback number.
Obtain patient name and DOB.
Open new case in CATC if transfer request order was not placed.
Connect sending physician with Interventional Cardiologist.
Sending physician texts a copy of the 12-lead EKG to the Interventional Cardiologist.
Confirm STEMI or emergent condition.
Notify CODE HEART Team via SPOK: WHC - Leader - CODE HEART.
Confirm receipt of message with Cath Lab RN.
Call MWHC STAT LINE to overhead page CODE HEART, ETA, and mode of transport.
Send 5-minute warning page to all team members.
Request facesheet from sending hospital.
Complete registration via MTC PFS team.
Complete SharePoint document, noting all times.
Confirm arrival and complete CATC chart.

quick_cath_transfer.title: Quick Cath Transfer
quick_cath_transfer.trigger: Transfer request for Quick Cath as designated by the Interventional Cardiologist.
steps: Arrange emergent transportation via MedSTAR Transport Request Teams chat.
Contact Interventional Cardiologist via AMiON.
Obtain sending physician name and callback number.
Obtain patient name and DOB.
Open new case in CATC if transfer request order was not placed.
Connect sending physician with Interventional Cardiologist.
If requested, sending physician texts a copy of the 12-lead EKG to the Interventional Cardiologist.
Notify CODE HEART Team via SPOK: WHC - Leader - CODE HEART.
Confirm receipt of message with Cath Lab RN.
Send 5-minute warning page to all team members.
Request facesheet from sending hospital.
Complete registration via MTC PFS team.
Complete SharePoint document, noting all times.
Confirm arrival and complete CATC chart.

stemi_in_house.title: STEMI In House
stemi_in_house.trigger: Call from MWHC physician for STEMI or emergent condition.
steps: Contact Interventional Cardiologist via AMiON.
Obtain physician name and callback number.
Obtain patient name and location.
Open new document in SharePoint.
Connect in-house physician with Interventional Cardiologist.
Sending physician texts a copy of the 12-lead EKG to the Interventional Cardiologist.
Confirm STEMI or emergent condition.
Notify CODE HEART Team via SPOK: WHC - Leader - CODE HEART.
Confirm receipt of message with Cath Lab RN.
Call MWHC STAT LINE to overhead page CODE HEART, ETA, and patient location.

quick_cath_in_house.title: Quick Cath In House
quick_cath_in_house.trigger: Call from MWHC physician for Quick Cath.
steps: Connect in-house physician with Interventional Cardiologist if not already done.
Sending physician texts a copy of the 12-lead EKG to the Interventional Cardiologist.
Notify CODE HEART Team via SPOK: WHC - Leader - CODE HEART.
Confirm receipt of message with Cath Lab RN.

cancellation.title: Cancellation Of Code Heart Or Quick Cath
cancellation.trigger: Sending or accepting physician cancels Code Heart or Quick Cath.
steps: Send page to Code Heart Group in SPOK.
Search Leader in directory.
Include cancellation type and patient name.
page_format: Cancelled Code Heart or Quick Cath

decision_points.question: Is the request from an accepting MedStar Interventional Cardiologist or Cardiology group?
yes: Follow the direction of the calling provider.
Destination may be Cath Lab or direct to a bed.
no: Contact on-call Interventional Cardiologist via AMiON.
If IC indicates NSTEMI, request transport to MWHC with destination pending.
Contact Bed Management for bed assignment: MHVI floor, 1F, or Cath Lab holding.
Once confirmed, send patient name, ETA, and bed assignment to accepting IC via Teams.
If there are delays, directly contact IC to determine how to proceed.

criteria: Hemodynamic instability due to cardiac etiology, including shock or hypotension
notes: Stable patient on fixed-dose drips may go to cardiac IMC.
MCVICU attending may direct patient to cardiac IMC.

other_call.title: Other Cardiac Or Interventional Call

Follow directions of the provider.
